summary: Combine deterministic intake contracts with reversible AI suggestions and feedback from downstream outcomes.

items.text: Store raw request, normalized version, model/version, confidence, accepted edits and final routing as one auditable intake record.
Learn from corrected owners, reopened duplicates and rejected classifications, but require review before taxonomy changes affect routing.
Use risk-tiered intake: auto-route routine work, request clarification for incomplete work and escalate security, legal or production-impacting reports.
See Prompt Enrichment Preprocessing for the related use case or counterpoint: Before execution, classify a generic request and visibly attach only the house context needed for that kind of work.
